AWS also continues to increase the efficiency of the
custom hardware and software we design to deliver AWS
services. Graviton2 is AWS’s most power-efficient processor,
providing better performance per watt than any other
processor we currently use. With the world’s increasing
need for compute and other IT infrastructure, continually
